## Introduction

This is a README for your civilization's upgrade.

Your species has produced thousands of policy proposals, most of which share a structural feature: they describe a pleasant world without describing a mechanism for reaching it. "We should have universal healthcare" is a destination, not a route. "We should end war" is a wish, not an engineering specification. Policy proposals on Earth work like recipes that list ingredients but skip the cooking instructions, then blame the chef when dinner does not materialize.

The Earth Optimization Plan v1 is different in exactly one way: it is an integrated system where every component creates the conditions for the next component. The treaty funds the trials. The trials generate returns. The returns pay the investors who funded the campaign that passed the treaty. The campaign creates voter demand that makes expanding the treaty easier than repealing it. Remove any one piece and the loop breaks. That is a weakness (harder to build) and a strength (you cannot lobby your way out of a machine whose parts check each other).

We think this plan is terrible. We also think it is better than what your species is currently doing, which is spending {{< var military_to_government_clinical_trials_spending_ratio >}} times more on weapons than on testing which medicines work, and calling this "civilization."

There is also a clock. Your [destructive economy](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd) [@gdp-trajectories-paper-2025] (military spending beyond deterrence plus cybercrime) is {{< var global_destructive_economy_pct_gdp >}} of GDP and growing faster than the productive economy. The Soviet Union collapsed at 15%. At current growth rates, yours hits 25% in {{< var destructive_economy_years_to_25pct_gdp >}} and 50% in {{< var destructive_economy_years_to_50pct_gdp >}}. There is a crossover point where the rational choice for any individual, company, or nation flips from "build things" to "steal things." You have a name for places where this already happened. You call them "failed states." There is no Colombia to flee to when the global economy is the failed state.

The [Earth Optimization Prize](earth-optimization-prize.qmd) [@earth-optimization-prize-paper-2025] is a standing challenge: fork this repository, fix anything idiotic, or replace the whole plan with something that scores better on the two terminal metrics. This paper is the starting entry. Every component is documented with what it does, what numbers it claims, and what a replacement must beat. Fork it. Improve it. Replace it entirely. We will be genuinely relieved.

## The Three-Sentence Version

Sell [Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) [@iab-paper-2025] that raise {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} to legally bribe politicians (via Super PACs and lobbying) into signing a [treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@value-captured-by-1pct-treaty] that redirects 1% of military spending to clinical trials. Of the resulting {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year, {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} funds trials through [your decentralized FDA](../solution/dfda.qmd) [@dfda-spec-paper-2025; @dfda-impact-paper-2025], {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} pays investors {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annual returns, and {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} funds a Super PAC that rewards politicians who voted yes. Returns grow in proportion to the treaty percentage, so every billionaire bondholder becomes a permanent lobbyist for expanding it, creating self-sustaining pressure to reallocate from death to life.

## How the Pieces Connect

The system has eleven required functions. The first ten form a loop; the eleventh becomes possible once the loop is running:

1. **[Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd)** raise {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} from investors who want {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns and billionaires who prefer not dying of horrible diseases.
2. That money funds the **lobbying campaign**: Super PACs, scorecards, legislative drafting, and post-office career guarantees. The **referendum campaign** runs separately on VOTE tokens (recruit a verified participant, earn tokens).
3. The campaign passes a **[1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025]** redirecting {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year from military budgets to clinical trials. Balance of power unchanged (everyone cuts the same 1%).
4. The **[Decentralized Institutes of Health](../solution/dih.qmd)** receives the funds and splits them: {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} to medical research, {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} to investor returns, {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} to political incentives.
5. The research treasury funds **[your decentralized FDA](../solution/dfda.qmd)** protocol, running pragmatic trials at {{< var dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient >}}/patient instead of {{< var traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient >}}/patient.
6. **[Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025]** governs how the research treasury is allocated: citizens do ~20 pairwise comparisons in 5 minutes, and the math produces budget weights.
7. The **[Evidence Machine](../solution/optimocracy.qmd)** ([Optimocracy](https://optimocracy.warondisease.org) [@optimocracy-paper-2025] + [OPG](https://opg.warondisease.org) [@opg-paper-2025] + [OBG](https://obg.warondisease.org) [@obg-paper-2025]) tracks which policies actually improve the two terminal metrics across thousands of jurisdictions.
8. The **[Political Dysfunction Tax](../problem/unrepresentative-democracy.qmd) [@political-dysfunction-tax-paper-2025]** and **[US Efficiency Audit](https://us-efficiency-audit.warondisease.org) [@us-efficiency-audit-paper-2025]** identify the waste pools ({{< var political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total >}}/year globally).
9. The **[legal architecture](../legal/legal-framework.qmd)** (treaty text, [Right to Trial](../solution/dfda.qmd) [@right-to-trial-paper-2025] & FDA Upgrade Act, statutory tools) creates binding force.
10. **[This book](/)** is the narrative and coalition wrapper that coordinates adoption.
11. **[Algorithmic monetary system](../futures/wishonia.qmd#the-algorithm-that-replaced-twelve-humans)** (Phase 2): once [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) eliminates the politicians who depend on the [money printer](../economics/central-banks.qmd), replace the Federal Reserve with a shared ledger targeting 0% inflation. The productivity dividend (new money that maintains stable prices as the economy grows) and a transaction tax flow into one pool, allocated entirely by [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd). UBI is one allocation category among many. No Cantillon effect, no wars funded without consent, no IRS, no welfare bureaucracy.

The loop closes: cured diseases generate popular support and economic returns, which fund further treaty expansion, which funds more trials. Each expansion multiplies all three revenue streams (investor, political, research). The system is designed so that the greedier its participants are, the faster diseases get cured.

## The Funding Engine

### The [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd)

Every signatory nation redirects exactly 1% of its military budget to the [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) Fund. That is {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year from {{< var global_military_spending_annual_2024 >}} in global military spending. Balance of power is preserved because every country cuts the same percentage. No country becomes more vulnerable. Your species has done harder things than this: you cut military spending by {{< var post_ww2_military_cut_pct >}} after WW2 and stumbled into the greatest economic boom in history [@value-captured-by-1pct-treaty; @1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025].

The treaty requires only 2 countries to enter into force. Reservations are not permitted (no creative accounting). Article VIII requires unanimous consent plus 10-year notice for withdrawal, because a treaty that can be abandoned next quarter is not a treaty; it is a suggestion with a flag.

The revenue split is {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}}/{{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}}/{{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}}: {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} to clinical trials (the point), {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} to investor returns (the bait), {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} to political incentives (the hook). The corruption is capped at 20% and fully transparent. The other {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} goes directly to clinical trials through [wishocratic allocation](../solution/wishocracy.qmd), where nobody with money gets to decide where it goes.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, your alternative must redirect at least as much low-value spending to higher-value use, without requiring any participant to become less selfish.

### [Decentralized Institutes of Health](../solution/dih.qmd)

The [DIH](../solution/dih.qmd) is a thin coordination protocol, not an organization. It does three things: receive treaty funds, allocate them via patient subsidies weighted by disease burden (DALYs) and infrastructure decisions via [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd), and verify results. Everything operational is outsourced to competing providers.

The researcher payment formula replaces the entire grant committee apparatus with one equation: subsidy per patient equals DALYs per patient times value per DALY, where value equals total budget divided by global disease burden. Diseases that kill more people get more funding. This is apparently a novel concept on your planet.

No CEO. No board. Every dollar on a public ledger. Anyone can build a competing alternative. The protocol is intentionally minimal to resist capture.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, your alternative must allocate research funding at least as efficiently with equal or better capture resistance.
:::

## The Medical Engine

### Your [decentralized FDA](../solution/dfda.qmd)

Your species has {{< var safe_compounds_count >}} known safe compounds. {{< var unexplored_ratio >}} of their potential uses have never been tested. At the current discovery rate, clearing the backlog takes ~{{< var status_quo_queue_clearance_years >}}. Your current clinical trial system costs {{< var traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient >}}/patient, has {{< var current_trial_slots_available >}} slots for {{< var current_disease_patients_global >}} patients who need them, and excludes 86% of the population.

[Your decentralized FDA](../solution/dfda.qmd) [@dfda-spec-paper-2025; @dfda-impact-paper-2025] is an open protocol (HTTP for clinical trials) that connects treatments to patients, records outcomes, and publishes results. Two stages: observational signal detection at ~{{< var dfda_observational_cost_per_patient >}}/patient, then pragmatic trial confirmation at ~{{< var dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient >}}/patient. At treaty funding, this expands trial capacity by {{< var dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier >}} and compresses the queue to ~{{< var dfda_queue_clearance_years >}}.

This is not theoretical. The Oxford RECOVERY trial tested 6 treatments on 48,000 patients for {{< var recovery_trial_cost_per_patient >}}/patient (versus {{< var traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient >}} standard), found dexamethasone cut COVID deaths by 30%, and saved {{< var recovery_trial_global_lives_saved >}} lives in {{< var oxford_recovery_trial_duration_months >}} months [@recovery-cost-500; @recovery-trial-1m-lives-saved]. Your species does its best medical research when terrified and disorganized.

Products: treatment search and rankings, [Outcome Labels](../solution/dfda.qmd) (nutrition-facts-style drug effectiveness summaries), real-time safety monitoring. The enabling legislation is the Right to Trial & FDA Upgrade Act, which eliminates the {{< var efficacy_lag_years >}} delay between proving a drug is safe and letting dying humans take it. For every 1 person protected from a dangerous drug, {{< var type_ii_error_cost_ratio >}} die waiting for a safe one [@invisible-graveyard-paper-2025].

::: {.callout-note}

## The Political Engine

### [Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd)

The obvious question: who funds a campaign to redirect military spending? Answer: people who want {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annual returns.

[Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) [@iab-paper-2025] fund the lobbying campaign. Buy a bond, your money goes to scorecards, PACs, legislative drafting, and post-office career guarantees for politicians who champion the treaty. If the treaty passes, you receive a pro-rata share of {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} of treaty funding flows: {{< var victory_bond_annual_payout >}}/year on {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} total bonds. That is {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annual returns, paid as a perpetual revenue share for as long as the treaty generates funding.

The secondary market price is a real-time, money-backed estimate of implementation probability. Every bondholder is financially incentivized to recruit voters, lobby politicians, fund implementation work, and share the plan, because all of these raise bond value. Nobody coordinates the lobbying campaign. The bond price coordinates it. And because investing is the [dominant strategy](../appendix/treaty-feasibility.qmd) regardless of whether a media cascade occurs, the system does not require virality to function.

Three-layer architecture for political adoption: (A) an independent organization publishes Public Good Scores based on politician voting records, (B) PACs and 501(c)(4)s support high-scorers with campaign funding, (C) foundations guarantee post-office careers for champions. No money flows directly to politicians. The same K Street mechanics, pointed at diseases instead of defense contracts. Scoring is based on public voting records; anyone can verify or publish competing scores, making the scoring organization [structurally difficult to capture](../appendix/optimocracy-paper.qmd).

The maximum cost of achieving any policy change through legal democratic channels is {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} for the United States, with ROI exceeding 400,000:1 [@cost-of-change-paper-2025]. "Political impossibility" is a capital allocation problem, not a physics problem.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, your alternative must make treaty passage at least as incentive-compatible for selfish actors, with equal or better investor returns.

### The Campaign

The campaign has two prongs: a [Global Referendum](global-referendum.qmd) and a lobbying operation.

The referendum proves that the support already exists. Everyone thinks ending war and disease is crazy because everyone else thinks it is crazy. Your economists call this pluralistic ignorance. The referendum is the moment eight billion people discover they nearly all agree. At {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} active participation (the Chenoweth threshold), no political movement has ever failed {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct_cite >}}. That is {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} humans. More than 10 times as many downloaded TikTok.

{{< var treaty_campaign_viral_referendum_base_case >}} of the campaign budget goes to paid referral bonuses that make sharing financially attractive. The lobbying budget ({{< var treaty_campaign_budget_lobbying >}}) outbids the defense lobby's annual spend ({{< var defense_lobbying_annual >}}/year) by a factor of 8.

Cash bonuses are the immediate incentive. The long-term incentive is VOTE tokens: transferable, on-chain proof issued to anyone who recruits a verified participant into the wishocratic allocation or treaty referendum. Recruiters can sell their tokens early; buyers are betting the plan succeeds. The secondary market price is a live estimate of what recruitment credit is worth.

The [Earth Optimization Prize](earth-optimization-prize.qmd) pool is a separate instrument from the bonds. PRIZE token buyers deposit funds into escrow earning interest. If global HALE has not reached {{< var wishonia_projected_hale_year_15 >}} and global median income has not reached {{< var wishonia_trajectory_avg_income_year_15 >}} by year 15, buyers get their deposit back plus interest (zero downside). If both targets are met, the entire pool is distributed to VOTE holders proportional to recruitment. A conditional donation: your money only spends if someone earned it. Philanthropists buy because they want to fund success. Pessimists buy for the risk-free interest. Both grow the prize pool.

::: {.callout-note}

To replace this component, your alternative must coordinate adoption at equal or lower cost and failure risk.

### Why Every Actor's Selfish Move Aligns

The system does not require anyone to become a better person. It requires each actor to do the thing they were already going to do, except [pointed at diseases](../solution/aligning-incentives.qmd):

| Actor | What they want | What the system gives them |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Defense contractors | Revenue | Keep 99% of budget + new health market worth {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year. The main difference is whether the end user survives. |
| Pharma | Cheaper trials, more revenue | Trials become revenue instead of cost; cost drops {{< var dfda_trial_cost_reduction_factor >}} |
| Insurance companies | Fewer claims | Cured patients stop filing; their lobbyists become your lobbyists |
| Politicians | Reelection + career | Super PAC funding + post-office careers proportional to treaty support |
| Billionaires | Returns + not dying | {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns + their diseases get cured too |
| Lobbyists | Clients + salary | Same job, same salary, different client; Wikipedia page improves |
| Regular humans | Health + income | Diseases cured + {{< var treaty_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} lifetime income gain |

The Olsonian problem (concentrated interests beat diffuse beneficiaries) is solved by creating concentrated interests on the pro-health side. Bondholders, politicians receiving PAC funding, defense contractors accessing the new health market: all now have per-capita stakes in the treaty's survival that match or exceed the defense lobby's per-capita stakes in the status quo.

## The Information Engine

### The Evidence Machine

[Optimocracy](../solution/optimocracy.qmd) [@optimocracy-paper-2025] measures two terminal metrics (median healthy life years and median real after-tax income) across ~10,000 jurisdictions running natural experiments. The [Optimal Policy Generator](https://opg.warondisease.org) [@opg-paper-2025] turns that data into enact/replace/repeal recommendations. The [Optimal Budget Generator](https://obg.warondisease.org) [@obg-paper-2025] does the same for spending. Combined: "What works?" answered by data, not argument.

The [Political Dysfunction Tax](../problem/unrepresentative-democracy.qmd) [@political-dysfunction-tax-paper-2025] is the gap between actual governance output and optimal-governance output: {{< var political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total >}}/year globally. The [US Efficiency Audit](https://us-efficiency-audit.warondisease.org) [@us-efficiency-audit-paper-2025] itemizes {{< var us_gov_waste_total >}}/year across ten categories. These are the waste maps that tell you where the money is.

Why only two terminal metrics? Each additional metric creates a new Goodhart surface. Markets optimize profit, not 200 sub-metrics. Median income is hard to fake at scale. Mortality is binary. Every major policy domain (employment, healthcare, environment, education) [flows through](../appendix/optimocracy-paper.qmd) income and mortality; what doesn't affect how long you live or how much you earn probably isn't worth optimizing. Two numbers. Your species can probably keep track of two numbers.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, your alternative must generate better policy and budget recommendations under real-world constraints, and identify low-value spending pools at least as well.

## The Governance Engine

### [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd)

[Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025] asks citizens to drag a slider between two random budget priorities. "How would you split $100 between cancer research and malaria prevention?" About 20 comparisons, 5 minutes. Statistical models (Bradley-Terry/PageRank) aggregate millions of pairwise judgments into budget-preference weights without speeches, lobbying, or horse-trading.

Why pairwise comparisons? Random pairs prevent gaming (no ballot measure to advertise for). Independence is structurally guaranteed (no spoiler candidates, no strategic voting). Outliers cancel out. Your species tried direct democracy four times (Athens, California propositions, Brexit, Swiss referendums) and each failed for a specific reason that pairwise comparison structurally prevents.

In Phase 1, [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) governs how the {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} research treasury is allocated, and infrastructure decisions within the DIH. In Phase 2, it governs the entire public goods budget: the productivity dividend and transaction tax revenue from the [algorithmic monetary system](#the-monetary-system-phase-2) flow through [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd), with UBI as one allocation category among many. It is scope-locked to bounded allocation questions. You cannot use it to vote on rights, bodies, or anything unbounded.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, your alternative must recover public preferences at equal or lower cognitive cost, with equal or better resistance to capture by organized factions.
:::

## The Legal Architecture

The [legal framework](../legal/legal-framework.qmd) has four parts:

1. **Treaty text.** Articles I-VIII of the [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd), modeled on the Chemical Weapons Convention (193 signatories). Proportional reduction, no reservations, 10-year withdrawal notice.
2. **Right to Trial & FDA Upgrade Act.** Eliminates the {{< var efficacy_lag_years >}} efficacy delay for drugs that pass Phase I safety. Replaces a smoke detector that works by mail with real-time safety monitoring.
3. **[Legislation package](legislation-package.qmd).** The statutory tools for domestic implementation in each signatory country.
4. **[Election law compliance](../legal/election-law.qmd).** The IAB mechanism operates within existing campaign finance law (Citizens United, FEC advisory opinions, 501(c)(4) rules).

### The Organizational Structure

You need to fight on three fronts: moral (charity), political (lobbying), and financial (investment). Your legal system says one organization cannot do all three. Your legal system is adorably complicated, like a board game designed by lawyers having a nightmare. So you build a four-part machine:

- **The Charity (501c3).** Research and education. Foundations give money here and get tax deductions.
- **The Lobbying Group (501c4).** Takes the research and wages unlimited political warfare (mostly lunch meetings and PowerPoints).
- **The Corporation (C-Corp).** Issues the VICTORY [Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) and collects investment capital. Yes, you need a for-profit corporation to end death.
- **The Swiss Foundation.** The parent organization owns the corporation, ensuring profits can only fund the mission. You put it in Switzerland because they are good at keeping things neutral and also chocolate.

This structure lets you legally accept money from foundations, political donors, and investors, and aim it all at diseases instead of each other.

::: {.callout-note}

## The Monetary System (Phase 2)

The [central-banks chapter](../economics/central-banks.qmd) makes the case that the money printer is the root cause: every war that killed more than a million people required one, the hard-money list is empty, and the Cantillon effect has transferred 93% of your purchasing power from workers to whoever stands closest to the printer since 1913. A plan that claims to optimize Earth but ignores the monetary system is a plan that fixes the symptoms and leaves the disease.

V1 does not fix this in Phase 1. The treaty, the bonds, and your [decentralized FDA](../solution/dfda.qmd) all operate within existing fiat currencies. This is deliberate. Replacing the Federal Reserve requires eliminating the politicians who depend on it, which requires [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) to be running, which requires the treaty to pass, which requires the bonds to sell. You cannot skip to the end.

Phase 2 (post-treaty, post-[Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd)) replaces the money printer with an algorithmic monetary system described in [Wishonia](../futures/wishonia.qmd#the-algorithm-that-replaced-twelve-humans). The core mechanism: a shared ledger targeting 0% inflation. When the economy grows, the algorithm creates exactly enough new currency to keep prices stable. That new money is the productivity dividend, flowing through [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) as the global public goods budget. No congressional budget process. No lobbyist.

A transaction tax (automatic, collected by smart contract) provides the second stream. Both flow into one pool; [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) allocates the entire thing. UBI is one allocation category among many, not a constitutional carve-out. The [Optimitron](../solution/optimocracy.qmd) shows the ROI of each option; the aggregate produces a natural equilibrium.

Together, three pieces of software (the monetary algorithm targeting 0% inflation, the transaction tax contract, and [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd)) render redundant: the Federal Reserve, the IRS, income tax, the congressional budget process, every welfare program, grant committees, the lobbying industry, and the financial sector.

This is v1's most honest gap. The system that funds wars without democratic consent, steals 2% of purchasing power per year by design, and channels genius toward weapons instead of medicine is not addressed until Phase 2. A v2 that solves this earlier, without breaking the Phase 1 sequencing, would be strictly better.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fork Marker
To replace this component, design a transition path from fiat to algorithmic money that does not require the treaty to pass first, or prove that the treaty can pass faster without monetary reform.
:::

## The Ratchet

The system is designed to ratchet. Three reinforcing loops ensure the treaty percentage increases but never decreases:

**Loop 1: Cures create voters.** Every disease cured by treaty-funded trials creates a constituency of formerly dying humans who now vote. Repealing the treaty means telling cured patients "we would like to stop curing diseases now." No politician survives that sentence.

**Loop 2: Returns create lobbyists.** Bondholder returns scale with treaty percentage. Every expansion from 1% to 2% doubles investor income. Every bondholder becomes the world's most motivated lobbyist for expansion. Not because they care about diseases. Because they care about money.

**Loop 3: The Super PAC creates career incentives.** The {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} political incentive fund rewards politicians proportional to their treaty support. More treaty funding means more PAC money means more politicians competing to be the most pro-treaty candidate.

All three loops compound. The ratchet only turns one way.

### The Expansion Math

The treaty money splits [80/10/10](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd): {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}} to clinical trials (the point), {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} to investors (the bait), {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} to [political incentives](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd) (the hook). That last slice grows every time the treaty expands:

| Treaty % | Political Incentive Pool | What Happens |
|:---------|:------------------------|:-------------|
| 1% | {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_annual >}}/year | Treaty passes. Humans cautiously try not dying. |
| 2% | $5.44B/year | Politicians compete to expand (they've discovered voters like living) |
| 5% | $13.6B/year | Health lobby rivals defense lobby. Lobbyists switch suits. |
| 10% | $27.2B/year | "Funded pragmatic clinical trials" becomes the most rewarded phrase in politics |
| 25% | $68B/year | Superpowers compete on health outcomes (much less radioactive) |
| 50%+ | $136B+/year | Historians write confused books about why this took so long |

**Bond investors** get {{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} of all treaty funds. At 1%, that is {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns. At 2%, it doubles. At 10%, they collect ten times their original payout. Every bondholder calls their senator, not because they care about diseases but because they care about money. You do not have to ask them to do this. They will do it automatically, the way a plant grows toward sunlight except the sunlight is money and the plant is a billionaire. You have built a defense lobby in reverse.

**Politicians** see their [IAB-funded rewards](../appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.qmd) grow with each expansion. By 10%, the political incentive pool ($27.2B/year) exceeds all current global lobbying combined. "I support pragmatic clinical trial funding" becomes the most profitable sentence a politician can say, which means they will say it constantly, which means they will eventually believe it. This is how your species forms convictions.

## The Sequencing

You cannot skip steps. All timelines below are order-of-magnitude estimates, not promises.

**Phase 1: The [Least Bad Idea Prize](earth-optimization-prize.qmd#the-least-bad-idea-in-the-world-prize) (weeks to months).** Run the design competition. Teams fork v1, fix it, or replace it. Expert panel filters for [constitutional compliance](earth-optimization-prize.qmd#constitutional-constraints). Adversarial review catches what the panel misses. [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) ranks the survivors via pairwise comparison. The winner becomes the Earth Optimization Plan v2. PRIZE token sales begin during this phase, funding the prize pool regardless of which plan wins. This is the cheapest stage and it stress-tests the plan before committing real resources.

**Phase 2: The [referendum](global-referendum.qmd) (weeks to months).** Launch the [PRIZE token](earth-optimization-prize.qmd) sale and referendum platform simultaneously. Each participant votes on the [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) (the headcount that creates political pressure) and sets a [wishocratic slider](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) for their preferred military-to-health allocation (the data that tells you what people actually want). Every recruiter who brings a verified participant earns VOTE tokens. The PRIZE pool size and referendum headcount become the pitch to investors. If 280 million people say their preferred split is 5%, that is ammunition for the ratchet before it even starts.

**Phase 3: Pass the treaty (months to years).** Scale the referendum to {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} verified participants. Launch the full VICTORY [Incentive Alignment Bond](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) sale ({{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} target). Overwhelm the defense lobby ({{< var defense_lobbying_annual >}}/year) with 8x their spend. Pass the treaty. {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year begins flowing.

**Phase 4: Full optimization (years to decades).** Treaty expands from 1% to 2% to 5% to 50%+. Each expansion multiplies all three revenue streams. [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) governs how the research treasury is allocated. Once [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) is running at scale, replace the Federal Reserve with the [algorithmic monetary system](../futures/wishonia.qmd#the-algorithm-that-replaced-twelve-humans). A transaction tax replaces the IRS. UBI becomes one wishocratic allocation category among many. Three pieces of software replace the entire fiscal and monetary apparatus.

## The Numbers

The ROI is astronomical because three compounding engines run simultaneously. **Engine 1: R&D spillover.** Redirect engineers from missiles to medicine. Every dollar of R&D produces {{< var rd_spillover_multiplier >}} in economy-wide productivity gains; military R&D produces approximately none (classified, non-transferable, designed to destroy). **Engine 2: Disease burden reduction.** Disease currently costs {{< var disease_burden_gdp_drag_pct >}} of GDP in sick workers, medical bills, and lost productivity. Cure the diseases, recover the GDP. **Engine 3: Governance improvement.** The [Optimitron](../solution/optimocracy.qmd) identifies {{< var political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total >}}/year in political dysfunction. Fix even a fraction and the gains compound. All three run for 20 years. Cut every assumption in half, then in quarters. The model still produces a civilization instead of a collapse.

## What We Think Is Wrong

Your policy papers never have a section called "Where We Think We Are Wrong." This one does.

These are the failure modes we consider most likely, ordered by severity. If you are building v2, start here.

### 1. The First Billion

Everything depends on raising {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} in initial IAB capital. If no billionaire buys in, the cascade never starts. The [chain reaction model](../appendix/treaty-feasibility.qmd#sec-chain-reaction-model) says that even with {{< var chain_dismiss_probability >}} dismissal, approximately {{< var chain_expected_engaged_implementers_nounit >}} of {{< var chain_implementer_count_nounit >}} billionaires and heads of state engage within {{< var chain_horizon_years_nounit >}} years. The math is reassuring. The math has not met your billionaires. This is the single highest-risk node in the system.

**How to beat this:** PRIZE tokens provide the assurance contract: philanthropists get {{< var prize_escrow_100_return_multiple >}} over {{< var prize_escrow_accumulation_years >}} even if the plan never produces results, making the bet rational for pessimists. IAB investors take real risk (money funds the lobbying campaign), but the revenue share on success ({{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annually) makes the expected value positive even at low success probabilities. The [decision-theoretic case](../appendix/treaty-feasibility.qmd) shows investing is the dominant strategy even without a cascade. What neither proves is that real billionaires evaluate payoff matrices. A pilot at $10M that demonstrates the loop before asking for {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} would reduce this from a modeling question to an empirical one.

### 2. The 20% Overhead Question

The {{< var dih_treasury_medical_research_pct >}}/{{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}}/{{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} split is a design choice, not a theorem. The combined overhead ({{< var victory_bond_funding_pct >}} investor returns + {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} political incentives) looks terrible to philanthropists who expect 95% program ratios. It looks excellent to investors who expect {{< var average_market_return_pct >}} returns. Whether the investor-attraction benefit exceeds the philanthropist-repulsion cost is an empirical question nobody has answered. The split may be wrong.

**How to beat this:** Prove that a different split raises more total capital or produces better outcomes per dollar. Or prove that the 20% is unnecessary because a cheaper political mechanism exists.

### 3. [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) Participation

If participation in wishocratic allocation is low, the allocations are noisy and manipulable by organized factions. The system requires thresholds, weighting, or fallback modes for low participation. We have specified these. We have not tested them.

**How to beat this:** Prove that a different allocation mechanism produces better outcomes with lower participation requirements, or design stronger participation incentives.

### 4. No Pilot

We have not tested any of this as an integrated system. The RECOVERY trial proves pragmatic trials work. The Montreal Protocol proves coordinated reduction works. The NRA proves political scoring works. But the integrated loop has never run. Individually validated components can fail when combined, the same way individually safe chemicals can explode when mixed.

**How to beat this:** Run a pilot. A single country, a single disease category, a scaled-down version of the full loop. Prove the integration works before asking for planetary adoption.

## Fork Instructions

The Earth Optimization Plan v1 is the starting benchmark for the [Earth Optimization Prize](earth-optimization-prize.qmd). To submit v2:

1. **Fork.** Clone [the repository](https://github.com/mikepsinn/disease-eradication-plan). Every component, every calculation, every assumption is public.
2. **Replace any row** in the Minimum Acceptable Governance table (see the [prize paper](earth-optimization-prize.qmd)) with something strictly better on the two terminal metrics (median healthy life years and median real after-tax income).
3. **Or replace the whole system** with an integrated alternative that dominates v1 function by function. You cannot skip inconvenient pieces; every required function must be covered or replaced.
4. **Prove it.** The credit mechanism is VOTE tokens: transferable, on-chain proof of how many verified participants you recruited into the wishocratic allocation or treaty referendum. You need numbers, not arguments.
5. **Collect.** Bondholders receive their revenue share for as long as the treaty generates funding. VOTE token holders receive their share of the PRIZE pool when both global targets are met at year 15 (HALE {{< var wishonia_projected_hale_year_15 >}}, median income {{< var wishonia_trajectory_avg_income_year_15 >}}).

The disqualification rule: if your proposal requires any participant to become less selfish, you have described a pleasant world rather than a mechanism for reaching it. The math must work when humans are greedy, impatient, and exactly as self-interested as they are right now.

We wrote v1 because competitions need a starting entry. There are 8 billion of you and AIs that are almost certainly smarter than its authors. Finding something better should not be difficult.

We expect to lose. We look forward to it.
